description: Ivan Posey looks forward to taking all questions asked at the League of Women Voters of Fremont County Forum in Riverton on October 8th at 6 PM. The LWV forums have been a long-standing opportunity for voters to hear from the candidates who seek to represent them. Ivan will be there!
title: Ivan Looks Forward to the LWV Forum on October 8th — Ivan Posey for House District 33
